summary: Implemented class_registry.register (keyed by bare classname and module-qualified path, replacing same-module redefinitions and keeping same-name classes from different modules) and class_registry.get_class (RegistryError for missing or ambiguous names, with all=True returning the list), and added the abstract serialize/deserialize/_serialize/_deserialize and dump/dumps/load/loads declarations to base.py; types.py needed no change. The last full-suite run I saw failed at import with a TypeError because _get_fields in schema.py (another builder's file) is still a stub, so no pass or fail counts were produced.
